subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this modular dashboard as a bundled core plugin stack, route it to ClawHub/external plugin work, or first narrow it into missing plugin/API seams?
rationale: The request is a broad user-facing Control UI product direction with persistent state, agent tools, gateway RPCs, and custom browser-rendered widgets; code review alone cannot decide the core-bundling and trust-boundary policy.

options.title: Design-gate then review stack
options.body: Keep this issue open, review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101094 first, and require maintainer-approved storage/security/product boundaries before later UI/widget PRs land.

options.title: Externalize to ClawHub/plugin
options.body: Treat the dashboard as an optional plugin package and keep core work limited to any missing generic plugin APIs proven necessary by the stack.

options.title: Reject bundled direction
options.body: Close the stack as not planned for core and ask for narrower issues only for specific missing extension seams or existing Control UI bugs.

recommendation.title: Design-gate then review stack
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101094 first, and require maintainer-approved storage/security/product boundaries before later UI/widget PRs land.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent current-main history for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and bundled Logbook tab points to Peter Steinberger as the best routing owner for the product boundary choice.
